task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

Go into the target room only after the locked door has been opened.
Open the locked door only after the matching key has been picked up.
Pick up the matching key only after it has been found.
Pick up the ball only after going into the target room.
